title: The Stolen Symphony
logline: A washed-up composer hires a pilot to extract a forgotten colonial symphony from a locked archive using bribes and courier routes, so they can pass it off as their grand comeback.

roles.description: Theatrical, desperate for fame, wearing outdated fashion.
Protective of history, extremely pedantic about copyright.
An opulent, acoustically perfect orbital theater.
A monolithic, heavily guarded repository of colonial data.
A ruthless guild of critics and producers.

public_situation: The {role:plagiarist_composer} has announced a grand comeback premiere at the {role:symphony_hall}, but hasn't actually written any music yet.
private_truth: The composer plans to pass off an ancient lost colonial symphony as their own work, and needs a pilot to extract the only copy from the {role:historical_archive}.

beats.public_change: The composer begins booking the hall and hyping up a masterpiece.

missions.reason: The composer needs a pilot to run diagnostic scans on the archive's data vaults, mapping out exactly where the symphony crystal is held.
missions.private_fact: The scans also reveal which guard shifts are underpaid and most vulnerable to a bribe.

beats.public_change: The archivist notices unusual network activity and prepares to lock down the vaults.

missions.reason: The composer has arranged a bribe for an archivist clerk. The pilot must dock at the service bay and collect the crystal before the lockdown.
missions.private_fact: The crystal emits a loud, hypnotic hum that makes it impossible to hide if an inspector walks by.

beats.public_change: The archivist realizes the crystal is missing and calls in syndicate enforcers to intercept it.

missions.reason: The composer needs the pilot to deliver the crystal directly to the conductor's podium before the premiere is ruined.
missions.private_fact: The archivist intercepts the pilot at the hall, demanding the crystal back under threat of syndicate blacklist.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the ancient crystal. The archivist blocks the way, demanding it back.

options.label: Give the crystal to the archivist

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the crystal to the podium.
resolutions.summary: The premiere is a massive success. The composer becomes a legend, and the archivist is laughed out of the syndicate.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a fraud steal a masterpiece and get away with it.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the crystal to the archivist.
resolutions.summary: The archivist proves the theft. The composer is blacklisted, and the ancient symphony is safely locked away in a vault.
The crystal shatters. The music is lost forever. Both the composer and the archivist are devastated.

loose_threads.detail: The crystal's data structure matches known artifacts from the first wave colonists.
The composer casually mentions they had to bribe three separate syndicate judges just to get the hall booked.

radio_hooks: Excitement builds for mysterious premiere at {role:symphony_hall}.
{role:angry_archivist} claims historical records have been tampered with.

voice_direction.plagiarist_composer: Loud, dramatic, speaks with their hands.
